name: Roses in The Flames
source:
You are the main character who had the mysterious fate of walking through a magical pond and only to discover after resurfacing, you find out it's a world inhabited by Dragons.

At first, everything seemed so strange after meeting the first dragon, and then the second. After seeing this world for yourself you realize it's not so bad to be living in Draconia. However, living with dragons comes with its own problems. 
[From [url=https://cringledragons.itch.io/roses-in-the-flames]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
你是主角，有着神秘的命运，穿过一个神奇的池塘，当你重新出现时，你发现这是一个龙居住的世界。

起初，在遇到第一条龙之后，一切都显得那么奇怪，然后是第二条龙。亲眼目睹这个世界后，你会意识到生活在德拉科尼亚并没有那么糟糕。然而，与龙一起生活也有其自身的问题。
[来自[url=https://cringledragons.itch.io/roses-in-the-flames]itch.io[/url]]
